notes: Trigger evaluations for the tui-design skill description. No measured trigger rate is claimed until the full set is run (see README.md). T = should trigger, N = near-miss that should not.
harness: evals/run_trigger_evals.py --harness claude|codex (sequential, fresh temp project per query)

queries.query: I'm building a terminal app to manage my docker containers. Can you design the layout, keybindings and empty/error states before I write any code?
Quiero hacer una TUI para gestionar mis notas en el terminal, con lista a la izquierda y preview a la derecha. Diseñame el layout y los atajos de teclado.
Here's a screenshot of my terminal app, the status bar looks off and I can't tell which pane is focused. What would you change? [screenshot of a two-pane terminal UI attached]
Te paso una captura de mi TUI en Ratatui: los paneles se ven muy cargados y el foco no se distingue. ¿Qué mejorarías?
I'm writing a herdr plugin that shows a side panel with the running agents and their status. How should I lay out the panel so it reads well in a narrow 40-column pane?
I want a tmux popup (display-popup) that lists my git branches and lets me switch with j/k and enter. Help me design how it should look and behave.
Estoy haciendo un plugin de Neovim que abre una ventana flotante con una lista de tareas navegable con teclado. ¿Cómo diseño la interfaz para que sea clara y no se rompa al redimensionar?
The columns in my table view are misaligned whenever a row has a Japanese filename, everything after it shifts right. How do I fix the widths?
Mi lista en la terminal se descuadra cuando hay emojis en los nombres, el borde derecho queda desalineado. ¿Cómo calculo el ancho correcto de las celdas?
My interactive terminal dashboard should respect NO_COLOR and still be usable when colors are off. Which states rely on color alone right now and what should replace them?
In Bubble Tea, how should I structure the model and Update for a three-pane file browser so that resizing and focus changes don't glitch the layout?
I'm building a Textual app for browsing logs. Help me pick the screen layout, the footer key hints and how to show a loading and empty state.
Con Ink estoy haciendo un asistente interactivo para configurar proyectos; ¿cómo organizo los pasos, los atajos y los mensajes de error para que se sienta pulido?
Map the Catppuccin Mocha palette onto my terminal UI: which colors for borders, selected row, dim text, warnings and errors so contrast stays readable on 16-color terminals?
I want my Kubernetes pod viewer to feel like k9s or lazygit: dense panes, a one-line key hint bar, a command prompt. Where do I start with the layout?
Build me an fzf-style fuzzy picker in Go with a prompt line, a filtered list that highlights the matches and a preview window on the right. Make the UI feel right.
I need a live terminal dashboard showing CPU, memory and a request log, like btop. How should I arrange the widgets and what refresh behavior avoids flicker?
Design a responsive admin dashboard in React with a sidebar, a data table and dark mode toggle using Tailwind.
I'm building a macOS app in SwiftUI with a sidebar and a detail view. How do I handle window resizing and toolbar items?
Can you give me a Ghostty config with a Catppuccin theme, JetBrains Mono at 14pt and a bit of window padding?
¿Cómo cambio la paleta de colores de iTerm2 a Dracula y activo la transparencia de la ventana?
I want to write my own Neovim colorscheme in Lua. How do I define highlight groups for Treesitter and LSP diagnostics?
How do I set up a Nerd Font in the VS Code integrated terminal so the icons show up?
Write a bash script that backs up a directory to a tarball, rotates the last 7 copies and logs to a file. No interaction needed, it runs from cron.
Add pagination and rate limiting to my Express REST API for the /orders endpoint. Show the route handlers and the middleware.
Necesito un dashboard en CSS puro con grid, tarjetas de métricas y gráficos responsivos que se vean bien en móvil.
In my Jupyter notebook the matplotlib plots are tiny and the legend overlaps the lines. How do I fix the figure size and layout?
How do I add subcommands and a --verbose flag to my Python CLI with argparse, and generate the --help text automatically?
Help me theme my starship prompt: show git branch, python version and a right-aligned clock with a gruvbox-like color palette.
What's the cleanest way to rebase a feature branch onto main, squash the fixup commits and force-push safely?
